For a 2BHK in Hyderabad, I’d shortlist:

Asian Paints Beautiful Homes Painting Service — Best for a structured, supervised job. Site inspection, colour consultation and documented scope. 
Asian Paints

AapkaPainter — Good local option; compare its quote against branded providers.

Urban Company Hyderabad — Convenient marketplace option with Asian Paints, Berger and Dulux choices; listed interior options start roughly ₹6–₹26/sq ft depending on product. 
Urban Company

What to check:

Full surface prep: crack filling, putty, primer and sanding

Number of coats and exact paint brand/grade

Labour + material + furniture masking/cleanup included

Timeline and daily supervision

Warranty/defect rectification

GST and any “extra work” charges

Get 3 itemised quotes after site inspection, not just per-sq-ft estimates.
